dialogue.content: こんばんは、どうぞよろしくお願い致します。すみません、パソコン不倶戴天の為、携帯でさせて頂きますので、ご不便をおかけするかも知れませんので、どうぞよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Good evening. It's a pleasure to speak with you. I apologize, but I'm having some serious trouble with my computer, so I'll be conducting this session from my phone. I'm sorry if this causes any inconvenience, and I appreciate your understanding.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you, it's a pleasure to speak with you as well.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 就職して一人ぐらしをしている娘の相談です
dialogue.English: It's about my daughter, who has a job and is living on her own.

dialogue.content: 娘そんなことですね。貴方の年代と性別を教えて頂けますか
dialogue.English: I see, it’s about your daughter. May I ask your age range and gender?

dialogue.content: 50代、女性です
dialogue.English: I’m a woman in my fifties.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。娘さんの、ことで、どうしましたか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. So, what has been happening with your daughter?

dialogue.content: 娘は以前彼氏がいて、2年ほど付き合った時に家に連れてきました。でもその後いつの間にか別れて今は別な人と付き合っているようです
dialogue.English: My daughter used to have a boyfriend, and after they had been dating for about two years, she brought him home. But then, before I knew it, they had broken up, and now it seems she’s dating someone else.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！娘さんのことで、一緒に考えて行きたいので、少し聞かせて頂いても、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. I'd like to work through this with you, so would it be all right if I ask you a few questions?

dialogue.content: はい、別れた理由を聞いても言わないし
dialogue.English: Yes. For one thing, even when I ask why they broke up, she won't tell me.

dialogue.content: 家まで連れてくるぐらいですから男性も結婚を考えてくれていたと思うのです。
dialogue.English: Since she went so far as to bring him home, I believe he must have been thinking about marriage, too.

dialogue.content: はい、それは心配ですね。娘さんはおいくつでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I can understand why that would be a concern. How old is your daughter?

dialogue.content: 28歳です
dialogue.English: She’s 28.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.content: 家族構成を教えて頂けますか、
dialogue.English: Could you tell me about your family?

dialogue.content: 夫、私、娘、息子二人、息子の一人は結婚して別に住んでいます。。娘も一人暮らしです
dialogue.English: There's my husband, myself, our daughter, and two sons. One of our sons is married and lives elsewhere, and as I mentioned, my daughter also lives on her own.

dialogue.content: 5人家族だったのですね、
dialogue.English: So you were a family of five, then.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 貴方が50代で、ご主人や、息子さんの年代を教えて頂けますか
dialogue.English: You're in your 50s; could you tell me the age groups of your husband and sons?

dialogue.content: 夫60代、結婚している息子30代、もう一人の独身の息子20代
dialogue.English: My husband is in his 60s, our married son is in his 30s, and our other unmarried son is in his 20s.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.content: 2年も、付き合っていると、本当に結婚するのかと、思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: When they've been dating for two years, you can't help but think they might actually get married, can you?

dialogue.content: はい、遠方に住んでいますので二人で家に来てくれたので結婚すると思っていました
dialogue.English: Yes. Since she lives so far away, when the two of them came to our home together, I thought for sure they were going to get married.

dialogue.content: でも半年ぐらいで別れたようです。
dialogue.English: But it seems they broke up about six months after that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは、残念でしたね。せっかく楽しみにしていたのに、ご主人や、息子さんの方は娘さんのことを、どのように思っていますか、
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been disappointing, especially when you were looking forward to it. How do your husband and sons feel about your daughter’s situation?

dialogue.content: 男親はそのへんのことはサッパリわからないようです話題にもしません
dialogue.English: Her father doesn't seem to understand that sort of thing at all. He doesn't even bring it up.

dialogue.content: うん、うん、
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, I see.

dialogue.content: 息子もわざわざ話を持ち出士たりしませんし
dialogue.English: My sons don't go out of their way to bring it up, either.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 娘さんは、遠くにすんでいるのでは、なかなか、お会いできないのですね
dialogue.English: Since your daughter lives far away, you don't get to see her very often, do you?

dialogue.content: はい。自分の生活を楽しんでいるところもありますからなかなか帰って来ません
dialogue.English: Yes. She's also enjoying her own life, so she rarely comes home.

dialogue.content: 私も邪魔をしてはいけないと思い行きませんし
dialogue.English: And I don't go to visit her, because I feel like I would be intruding.

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまいますよね。娘さんの気持ちも知りたいですよね、今は別な方とお付き合いをされているのですね
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel that way. You want to know how your daughter is feeling, don't you? And she's dating someone new now, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい、別れて別な人と付き合っていると報告はしてくれました
dialogue.English: Yes, she did let me know that they broke up and that she's dating someone else now.

dialogue.content: うん、うん、報告して下さったのですね
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm, so she did let you know.

dialogue.content: でもまた同じことになるのではないか心配なんです
dialogue.English: But I’m worried the same thing will happen again.

dialogue.content: 親って、いつも心配が耐えないですよね
dialogue.English: As a parent, the worrying never ends, does it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 娘さんは、偉いと思いますよ
dialogue.English: I think your daughter is admirable.

dialogue.content: 何がでしょうか
dialogue.English: In what way?

dialogue.content: ちゃんと、報告してくれて、しっかりしていますよ
dialogue.English: She keeps you properly informed; that shows she's very responsible.

dialogue.content: いえ、それは私があれからどうなったかと尋ねるから仕方なくこたえたのです
dialogue.English: No, that was only because I kept asking what had happened, so she felt she had no choice but to answer.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。結婚となると、一生のことですもの、それだけ、真剣に考えていると思います
dialogue.English: I see. Well, marriage is a lifelong commitment, so I'm sure she's thinking about it that seriously.

dialogue.content: それは大事なことです
dialogue.English: That is very important.

dialogue.content: 最初の方とは、気持ちが合わない事が、半年でわかったのでしょう
dialogue.English: With her first boyfriend, perhaps she realized within those six months that they just weren't a good match.

dialogue.content: 娘ははっきり言いませんが、相手から断られたようです。
dialogue.English: My daughter doesn't say it outright, but it seems he was the one who broke things off.

dialogue.content: ですからまた今の彼氏とも同じようにならないかと心配なんです
dialogue.English: That’s why I’m worried the same thing might happen with her current boyfriend.

dialogue.content: それは、つらかったですね。娘さんは、自分で気の合う人を探していますので、どうか娘さんを、信じて待ってあげられますでしょうか
dialogue.English: That must have been painful for her. Your daughter is trying to find someone she's truly compatible with, so do you think you could trust her and be patient?

dialogue.content: はい、娘の幸せを願わない親はいませんから、いつも見守っていますが
dialogue.English: Yes... there isn't a parent alive who doesn't wish for their child's happiness, so I’m always watching over her, but...

dialogue.content: いつもついうるさく、きちんと生活できているか、彼氏とうまくいっているかを尋ねて怒らせてしまいます
dialogue.English: I always end up nagging her, asking if she's managing her life properly and if things are going well with her boyfriend, and it makes her angry.

dialogue.content: ラインでですが
dialogue.English: I do it over text messages, though.

dialogue.content: 娘さんは、遠く離れていても、ちゃんと、彼が出来たとか、別れたとか、お母さんに報告してくれて、ありがたいですね。長々、話してくれる娘さんは、いないと思いますけどそれだけ、お母さんの事を大切に思ってくれていますよね
dialogue.English: Even though she's far away, it's wonderful that your daughter still tells you things like when she has a new boyfriend or when they break up. Not many daughters would talk about these things at such length, and I think that just shows how much she cares about you.

dialogue.content: はい、それは親の身になってくれていると思います。でも親に心配をかけないようにと思い、本心を話しているのか、わからない時があります
dialogue.English: Yes, I do think she's trying to be considerate of my feelings as her parent. But because she's trying not to worry me, there are times I wonder if she's telling me her true feelings.

dialogue.content: 芸能人の自死が続いたときはとても心配でした
dialogue.English: I was very worried when that series of celebrity suicides was in the news.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。娘さんに、この人なら、一生いっしょに、居られる方がみつかったら、つれてきてね、と伝えてみては、いかがですか
dialogue.English: I see. How about trying to tell your daughter something like, 'When you find someone you feel you can be with for the rest of your life, please bring him home to meet us'?

dialogue.content: 色々と心配な事が多いですよね
dialogue.English: There are so many things to worry about, aren't there?

dialogue.content: お母さんが、元気で、前向きに生活していると、娘さんも、安心して生活が出来ます。どうか、娘さんに、信じているよと伝えて下さい。
dialogue.English: If you, her mother, are living a cheerful and positive life, your daughter will be able to live her own life with peace of mind as well. Please, try to let your daughter know that you trust her.

dialogue.content: ラインが既読になれば生きているからと毎日毎日ラインを送りました。そのくらい心配でした。
dialogue.English: I sent her a text message every single day, just thinking that as long as it was marked as 'read,' it meant she was alive. That's how worried I was.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、あまり、心配しすぎると、身体に来てしまいます。
dialogue.English: I see, that's what was happening. If you worry too much, it can take a toll on your own health.

dialogue.content: ご両親が立派に育てられた、娘さんですもの、こちらの自立、子ばなれも必要な時もあります
dialogue.English: She is the daughter you and your husband raised so well. Sometimes, it's also necessary for parents to find their own independence and let their children go.

dialogue.content: 心配する心を、どうか、ご両親で、何か趣味を見いだして、心をそちに向けて見て下さい。
dialogue.English: To help with the worry, perhaps you and your husband could find a hobby to do together and focus your minds on that.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound all right?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。言って頂いたようにやってみます
dialogue.English: Thank you very much. I’ll try to do as you've suggested.

dialogue.content: お時間が来てしまいましたので、どうか、祈っています。貴方ならきっと、出来るはずです。
dialogue.English: Our time is up now, but I will be wishing you the very best. I'm sure you can do it.

dialogue.content: はいやってみます。今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll try. Thank you very much for your time today.

dialogue.content: それでは、終了させて頂きます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: All right then, we will end the session here. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.
